name: Membership
looksLike: a site with content only members can access
a member area with account settings and resources
a club website with a private resource library
definition: A website that gives a defined group access to resources, services, or community features, with clear membership terms and an understandable account area.
goal: Help members access benefits and manage their participation.
audience: Current and prospective members of a group

sections.name: Membership overview
sections.purpose: Explain benefits, eligibility, and any costs.

sections.name: Join and account
sections.purpose: Make access, sign-in, and account recovery understandable.

sections.name: Member resources
sections.purpose: Organize the materials and services available to the member.

sections.name: Manage membership
sections.purpose: Explain status, preferences, renewal, and leaving.

mustHave: An understandable cancellation or exit route
avoid: Public exposure of private member information

prompts.short: Build a membership site with clear benefits, account access, member resources, and membership management.
prompts.detailed: Build a membership website for current and prospective members of a group. Help members access benefits and manage their participation. Include membership overview, join and account, member resources, manage membership. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Clear access and renewal terms.
